params.name: QUERY
params.value:
"DELETE FROM `" + context.parameter_VJP_Prefix + ".Sales_Set` " +
"WHERE Id IN (" +
"  WITH combined_ids AS (" +
"    SELECT CONCAT('VJP-', CAST(sl.documentId AS STRING), '-', CAST(sl.Id AS STRING)) AS joinedId" +
"    FROM `" + context.parameter_VUS_Raw_Env + ".salesCreditMemoLines` sl" +
"    JOIN `" + context.parameter_VUS_Raw_Env + ".salesCreditMemosDelta` d" +
"      ON sl.documentId = d.Id" +
"    UNION ALL" +
"    SELECT CONCAT('VJP-', CAST(sl.documentId AS STRING), '-', CAST(sl.Id AS STRING)) AS joinedId" +
"    FROM `" + context.parameter_VUS_Raw_Env + ".salesInvoiceLines` sl" +
"    JOIN `" + context.parameter_VUS_Raw_Env + ".salesInvoicesDelta` d" +
"      ON sl.documentId = d.Id)" +
"  SELECT joinedId FROM combined_ids)"
